{
  "dataset_name": "qsar_biodegradation",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "norm_v1_v2_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of V1 to V2, normalized by a small constant to prevent division by zero, providing a scale-invariant feature for distance calculations.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Improves KNN performance by providing a normalized relative scale between two continuous descriptors, reducing the impact of absolute magnitude.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V1 / (V2 + 0.1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "distance_to_global_mean_v8_v15",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance to the unsupervised global mean of features V8 and V15, acting as a prototype-distance feature.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 50.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Helps the distance-based model capture the geometric position of a sample relative to the center of the data distribution.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt((V8 - 37.05)**2 + (V15 - 9.93)**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v30_v31_interaction_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-scaled interaction between V30 and V31 to compress the long tail and provide a stable similarity metric.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces the influence of extreme values in distance calculations by applying a log transformation to the product of two continuous features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(V30 * V31)"
    },
    {
      "name": "structural_complexity_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of several integer count features (V3, V5, V7, V9, V11) representing overall structural complexity.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 150.0],
      "feature_family": "composite_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates sparse count features into a single dense dimension, improving the density of the neighborhood geometry.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V3 + V5 + V7 + V9 + V11"
    },
    {
      "name": "v12_deviation_from_zero",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of V12 from zero, capturing the magnitude of this descriptor regardless of sign.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a symmetric distance metric for V12, which is useful if the magnitude is more important than the direction.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(V12)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v36_v39_similarity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute difference between V36 and V39, acting as an internal similarity score between two continuous descriptors.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the KNN model to group samples that have similar relative values for V36 and V39.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(V36 - V39)"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_density_region_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator feature that is 1 if the sample falls within a high-density region defined by the means of V1 and V2.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Acts as a soft cluster assignment, helping the KNN model distinguish between typical and atypical samples in the feature space.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(np.logical_and(np.abs(V1 - 4.78) < 1.0, np.abs(V2 - 3.06) < 1.5), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v15_normalized_deviation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score-like normalization of V15 using its training set mean and standard deviation.",
      "value_range": [-7.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardizes the scale of V15, ensuring it contributes proportionally to the Euclidean distance metric.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V15 - 9.93) / 0.92"
    },
    {
      "name": "molecular_size_proxy",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Linear combination of V8 and V30, serving as a proxy for overall molecular size or weight.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 150.0],
      "feature_family": "composite_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a dominant axis of variation that can help align the distance metric with a major physical property.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V8 + V30"
    },
    {
      "name": "v17_v18_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of V17 to V18, capturing the relative proportion of these two tightly bounded continuous features.",
      "value_range": [0.5, 1.5],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights subtle structural differences that might be obscured by the absolute values of V17 and V18.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V17 / (V18 + 0.001)"
    },
    {
      "name": "semantic_cluster_assignment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "An unsupervised cluster assignment based on the overall molecular descriptor profile, assigning the molecule to one of 5 distinct structural clusters.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a categorical grouping that can be used to partition the search space or weight distances differently within distinct structural families.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "outlier_severity_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "A semantic score evaluating how anomalous the molecule's descriptor values are compared to the typical training set distribution.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "anomaly_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the KNN model to dynamically adjust neighborhood sizes or distance weights for samples that lie far from the main data manifold.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
